title: Our day at the Flower Dome
checked: Every reachable state checked (10 states, 10 steps). All 3 rules hold.

rules.rule: Every step can happen, and none is a dead end
rules.says: Each of the 9 states is reached from the start, and every path can still reach its end (home).

rules.rule: The photo we keep has no sneeze in it
rules.says: After the photo (snack and home) nobody is mid-sneeze: a sneezy photo is always taken again.
rules.path: Take away the nobody sneezed guard and it breaks in 8 steps: off we go, our stop, walk in, follow the path, look up, time for a photo, achoo! [no sneeze yet], click mid-sneeze.

rules.rule: We go home with a photo
rules.says: We only reach the snack and the train home once the photo is taken.
rules.path: Take away the photo first guard and it breaks in 6 steps: off we go, our stop, walk in, follow the path, look up, skip the photo.
